Three stylus pens are present: two resting diagonally across the screen (one black, one silver) and one black pen lying separately to the right.

artifact_observations.location: Silver stylus tip and body junction
artifact_observations.reasoning: The silver stylus resting on the screen has a physically impossible structure. The tip appears to merge into the body without a clear neck, and the metallic texture melts into the plastic grip area unnaturally. The orange tip also seems to float slightly above the rest of the pen body.
The black stylus lying on the table has a slight warping in its mid-section. The ridges on the grip do not align perfectly with the cylindrical perspective, suggesting minor geometric instability.
The circular logo containing the word 'palm' is slightly distorted. The letters are recognizable but lack the crisp vector sharpness expected of printed branding, showing slight edge bleeding.
